name: number-field
title: Number Field
description: A locale-aware numeric control with keyboard and press-and-hold steppers, range limits, currency formatting and associated validation.
example:
<NumberField label="Quantity" defaultValue={2} minValue={1} maxValue={20} />
<NumberField
  label="Budget"
  defaultValue={2500}
  formatOptions={{ style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' }}
  step={100}
/>
